1442094.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Ip65 weatherproof led string lights
- Connectable up to 100m lighting system
- Durable cable for indoor outdoor use

## Information
Illuminate your space with these durable LED String Lights, designed with a black rubber IP65 cable for reliable performance indoors and outdoors. Available in 5m and 10m connectable lengths, they can be joined together to create up to 100m of seamless lighting, making them ideal for both small patios and large gardens. The system allows you to easily customise the length required by simply connecting additional sections. Whether you need a short run for a balcony or an extended length for trees, fences, pergolas, or building exteriors, these lights give you full flexibility. The weather-resistant design ensures year-round use, from bright summer evenings to festive winter nights, while waterproof ends keep connections safe and secure. Featuring high-quality LED bulbs, these lights are both long lasting and energy efficient, providing consistent illumination with minimal power consumption. Choose from a range of finishes including Cool White, Warm White, Copper Gold or RGB Colour Changing to suit your mood or event. The strong rubber cable offers durability in all conditions while maintaining flexibility for easy installation. Perfect for creating atmospheric lighting in gardens, outdoor dining spaces, decking areas, and patios, these versatile string lights also work beautifully indoors, adding a touch of charm to parties, weddings, and special occasions. Built to withstand the elements and designed for ease of use, they bring dependable, stylish lighting to any setting.
